headline: South Africa Annual Inflation Accelerates to 5.2% in October on Rising Fuel Costs
summary: South Africa's headline annual consumer inflation accelerated to 5.2% in October from 4.5% in September, reaching its highest level since May 2024. Surging motor fuel prices drove transport costs higher.
why: South African inflation data guides the South African Reserve Bank's repo rate decisions.

impacts.name: South African Rand
impacts.why: Accelerating domestic price pressures alter central bank interest rate trajectory expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Surging fuel costs drove headline inflation above expectations ahead of the central bank's rate verdict.
